# Bespoke Auto Design

> Miami's premier XPEL-certified auto protection studio. Paint Protection Film (PPF), ceramic coatings, ceramic window tinting, and color change wraps for luxury and exotic vehicles.

## About

- Founder & Installer: Alessandro Monticelli
- Location: 7943 NW 64th St, Miami, FL 33166
- Phone: (786) 395-9172
- Email: sales@bespokeauto.design
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9 AM–6 PM, Saturday 10 AM–4 PM
- Established: 2018
- Authorized XPEL dealer with lifetime warranty on installations
- 5.0 ★ / 46 Google reviews
- Service areas: Miami, Brickell, Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Key Biscayne, Aventura, Sunny Isles, Bal Harbour, Miami Beach, Design District, Doral, South Florida

## Services

- [Paint Protection Film (PPF)](https://www.bespokeauto.design/paint-protection-film): XPEL Ultimate Plus self-healing PPF, 10-year warranty, full front from $1,499
- [PPF Packages](https://www.bespokeauto.design/ppf-packages): Full Front, Track, Full Body coverage
- [Stealth PPF](https://www.bespokeauto.design/stealth-ppf): XPEL Stealth matte/satin paint protection
- [XPEL Color PPF](https://www.bespokeauto.design/colorppf): Colored PPF in 16 shades for color change without paint
- [Ceramic Coating](https://www.bespokeauto.design/ceramic-coating): XPEL Fusion Plus nano-ceramic, multi-layer, from $799
- [Ceramic Window Tint](https://www.bespokeauto.design/ceramic-tint): XPEL XR Plus, 99% UV rejection, 98% IR heat rejection, Skin Cancer Foundation recommended, from $150
- [Color Change Vinyl Wrap](https://www.bespokeauto.design/color-change-wrap): 3M, Avery Dennison, KPMF films
- [Marine PPF/Ceramic/Tint](https://www.bespokeauto.design/marine): For boats and yachts
